answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the vine of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A pulse of per-task receipts records who did what, and the knoll of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing.
